Ok, so I use two plugins that change the title screen.
1) One is
SRD's TitleCommandCustomizer
which adds a “common event” between the menu choices (new game, continue...) this common event is the one in which I put the CTB_Bold plugin command which is:
$gameScreen.addPicturesAbove(Scene_Title)
2) The second plugin
(but maybe not much related)
is the
HimeWorks “Pre-Title Events” plugin
.
I have a
cutscene that is shown before the game starts
and then you are taken to the actual “Title Screen” (the classic one from rpg maker).
Also, hime's plugin has a parameter to decide whether to replace the “Title Screen” with a game map (the one where I take place the
initial cutscene
) and I've disabled the option so it shouldn't interfere with CTB_Bold.
